title: MapleStory Classic Warrior Build and Leveling Guide: Lv 1-30
intro: Warriors are MapleStory's front-line melee class. They train under Dances with Balrog in Perion, build around STR, and spend their first 30 levels learning Power Strike and Slash Blast before choosing Fighter, Page, or Spearman.

blocks.p: **Pros**

ul: Slash Blast hits up to four mobs from its first point.
High HP and strong physical armor.
Power Strike and Slash Blast are extremely DMG/MP efficient.
Access to the widest variety of weapon families.

blocks.p: **Cons**

ul: Short melee reach and limited mobility.

blocks.h2: Understanding Warrior's Accuracy & How Much Dex You Need

blocks.p: Before any build guide, we need to understand how Warrior Accuracy works in MapleStory Classic World. It affects every build and every recommended training spot.

blocks.note:
**Base Accuracy**
floor((1.2 x Total DEX + 2 x Level + 0.6 x Total LUK) / 2.5 + 10)
Total Accuracy is Base Accuracy plus direct Accuracy from equipment, scrolls, skills, and potions.

blocks.p: **+0.80** Base ACC per level
**+0.48** Base ACC per DEX
**+0.24** Base ACC per LUK
**+1.00** Total ACC per direct ACC

Warrior Accuracy comes from character level, DEX, LUK, direct Accuracy, and their passive Precise Strikes. **Character level contributes more Accuracy for Warriors than for any other advancing class.** COT2 players welcomed this change because a Warrior's Accuracy now scales strongly with level.

One character level adds as much Base Accuracy as about 1.67 DEX. Level also closes the penalty for fighting a higher-level mob. This is why gaining a few levels can fix a "bad map" faster than adding more base DEX.

blocks.note:
**Hit rate: level gap and mob Avoidability**
L = max(0, Mob Level - Your Level)
A = Total Accuracy x 100 / (10 x L + 255)
D = A - Mob Avoidability
Every mob has its own Avoidability value, which is its evasion stat. Your level gap adjusts Total Accuracy first, then the result is compared against the mob's Avoidability. A higher mob Avoidability or a mob above your level both raise the Accuracy you need.

blocks.p: Zombie Mushroom is level 24 with 14 Avoidability. Your hit rate changes with the level difference between you and the mob.

blocks.note: **Max Precise Strikes adds 20 direct Accuracy and 5% Critical Rate.** Check your level, gear, and Accuracy potion before committing more AP to DEX. STR gives Warriors much more damage.

blocks.p: These targets use each mob's Avoidability and the player level shown. The 100% column means you never miss. Fighting at a lower level raises the ACC requirement to hit.
Follow the Maple Island quests, equip the strongest weapon they give you, and leave for Victoria Island at level 10. Go to Perion and talk to Dances with Balrog for the Warrior advancement.

blocks.note: **Fun fact:** The Club is the best starting weapon for levels 1-4 because it is more likely than the Sword or Hand Axe to kill Maple Island mobs with one fewer hit on average. At level 5, switch to the Razor.

blocks.h2: Levels 10-30: Warrior skill build and leveling

blocks.p: Build Power Strike first for reliable kills, then finish Slash Blast and Precise Strikes.

**Henesys is the best general citizenship for a Warrior.** Citizenship opens at level 12. Go to Henesys Town Hall and sign with Arthur. Raymond sells Supreme Sniper Potion for +7 Accuracy over 15 minutes. Flint's later shop ranks add Overall Armor STR Scroll: Lesser and Gloves Attack Scroll: Lesser.
Kerning City favors evasion, crit damage, LUK, and INT. Citizenship discounts apply to eligible prices in your active town, so the discount does not reduce every shop item in the game.
Both skills cost 12 MP at max. Slash Blast also costs 8 HP. Use Slash Blast when you can hit at least three mobs.

blocks.note: **Slash Blast gets a small range increase at skill level 11.** Its reach changes from 130 px to 150 px. It already targets up to four mobs at skill Lv1.

table: Opens Max HP Increase; item HP recovery +7%.
130% damage to four mobs for 8 HP and 12 MP.

blocks.h3: How Max HP Increase changed in MSClassic

blocks.p: In pre-Big-Bang MapleStory, Max HP Increase added bonus Max HP every time a Warrior leveled. Taking it late meant permanently missing HP, so Warriors maxed it as early as possible.

MapleStory Classic World changed the skill to an immediate percentage of base Max HP. Skill Lv3 gives +12% Max HP and skill Lv15 gives +25%. Delaying it no longer costs HP from earlier levels. Classic World also raised base HP for every class, and Warriors receive the largest HP bonus from job advancements. Max HP Increase is still "a tad" useful, but maxing it is no longer recommended given limited SP in 1st job.

table: Uses the final 3 SP for +12% Max HP.

blocks.p: Second-job SP cannot be spent on first-job skills, so finish the first-job plan by level 30. Character Builder flags any build that breaks it.

Raise Precise Strikes earlier if accuracy issues are hurting your preferred grind map. MP potions cost real money and you can't afford to waste MP on missed hits. A mob-heavy party grind can also move Slash Blast ahead of Power Strike.

**Levels 10 to 30 hand you 61 SP and the six first-job skills cost 105 to max.** Power Strike and Precise Strikes earn their points on every map. Slash Blast is the one to trim when you train where mobs rarely clump. Max HP Increase gives +10% of base Max HP for a single point and 25% for all fifteen, so spend one point early and put whatever is left of the 61 first-job SP into it once Power Strike and Precise Strikes are done.

blocks.cap: Power Strike: your 260% one-target skill from level 10 through 70.
Slash Blast: hits up to four from lv 1; small range increase at lv 11.

blocks.p: Female Warriors can equip Steel Fitted Mail at level 15. Male Warriors get their first class overalls at level 20 with the Kendo Robe line. That gives female Warriors five extra levels with an overall that can take STR or DEX scrolls.

blocks.note: **Why overalls matter:** Lesser Overall STR, DEX, INT, and LUK scrolls give +1 at 100%. Intermediate scrolls give +2 at 60%. There are no STR, DEX, INT, or LUK scrolls for tops or bottoms in the current item data.

blocks.p: Every job can equip a Sauna Robe at level 30: Blue Sauna Robe for male characters and Red Sauna Robe for female characters. Warriors already have class overalls before then, so compare the base stats and scroll result before switching.

NiaMeowDB has an amazing tool called the Training Advisor (Recommended Training), personalized to your character and build on the Character Builder page. It helps you find the best mobs and maps to train on, ranked by EXP/hit or skill cast.

Every row requires a 100% hit rate. From level 15 onward, every spawn dies within two Power Strikes using your weakest possible damage roll. The level 10 picks allow up to four casts because Power Strike has only one skill Lv.

blocks.note: **What does minimum roll mean?** Your damage changes from hit to hit. The minimum roll is the weakest hit your current build can deal. A guaranteed 2-hit means even two of your weakest Power Strikes will kill the mob. Normal and high rolls may kill it sooner.

The EXP/min figures are Training Advisor estimates for the sample build shown in each row with Final Attack off. They compare maps under the same model; movement, looting, crowding, and your actual gear will change the result. Stirges and Flyeyes are excluded because Warriors will have a terrible time there.

blocks.note: **Running out of mesos is a real progression problem.** Max Power Strike costs 12 MP per cast. Use normal attacks when they finish a low-HP mob, use Slash Blast only when enough mobs are in range, and compare your EXP gain with the number of Lemons you burn.

blocks.p: Your hitbox is the box in front of your character where a melee attack lands. Weapon reach is how far forward that box goes. Every Warrior weapon has five basic attacks, three swings and two thrusts, and each one has its own box. The game picks one of the five at random for every attack. The numbers below are the average reach of one basic attack.

blocks.cap: Sword, Swing 1. Any monster whose body touches the blue box gets hit: 18-88 px in front of you, from 6 to 62 px above your feet.

blocks.p: Two-handed weapons reach a little farther. Scimitar averages 102 px per basic attack. The other two-handed swords and axes average 87-90 px, most one-handed swords and axes 86 px, and Long Sword and Gladius 74 px. Reach has a direct effect on DPS in practice. Longer reach makes mobs easier to hit from a distance and keeps them from getting close enough to hit you. Compare every weapon family in the weapon reach guide.

ol: **Adding DEX for first-job advancement.** MSClassic World has no stat requirement. Add DEX when equipment or a real Accuracy breakpoint needs it.
**Maxing Max HP Increase early from old habit.** It now gives a flat percentage of base HP. Delaying it does not permanently lose HP.
**Moving to a map where Power Strike misses.** A miss spends the same MP and deals no damage.
**Ignoring danger and the refill walk.** Warriors face tank often. A slightly lower EXP estimate can be better when the map is safer and much closer to town.

blocks.h2: Choose your second job at level 30

blocks.p: Return to Dances with Balrog in Perion after finishing the Warrior test. Your first-job AP and SP stay with you.
Swords or axes, Rage for nearby party members, and the highest Damage/MP result among Grummash's realistic level 70 builds.

blocks.p: Swords or blunt weapons, Threaten for enemy Speed and WDEF, plus the option to use a shield with one-handed weapons.

blocks.text: Continue with the Page level 30-70 guide

blocks.p: Spears or polearms, Iron Will for personal defense, long weapon reach, and no shield slot.
